prompt: Who was older, the guitar player for the Dugites from 1982-1983 or the lead singer of The Sports?
answer: Andrew Pendlebury, the Dugites’ guitarist from 1982–1983, was older. He was born in 1952, while The Sports’ lead singer Stephen Cummings was born on September 13, 1954—making Pendlebury about two years older.
